summary: 100-foot steel tower erected at Walker, Cass County, MN, in 1937 on the Chippewa National Forest; the FFLA list marks it gone. No source found describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: The 1937 build year comes only from the Forest Lookouts Minnesota list; the 1942 Forest Service publication corroborates the tower, its height and location, but not the year. Gone status is from the FFLA list; no removal date or reason found. The 2015 chapter report counts three standing Chippewa towers and names none, so it neither confirms nor rules out Walker. Two WebSearch calls and about six page reads used. Story is about 114 words, just under the 120-word floor, because the evidence is thin; not padded.
